arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: So truly with hardship comes ease; truly with hardship comes ease.
Truly it is in the remembrance of Allah that hearts find rest.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

arabic: وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا
translation: And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Truly Allah forgives all sins.
And those who strive for Us, We will surely guide them to Our ways.
Truly the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.
Truly Allah is with those who are patient.
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.

arabic: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
translation: The servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth in humility.

arabic: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ
translation: My Lord, grant me a sound entrance and a sound exit.

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ
translation: Successful indeed are the believers, those who are humble in their prayer.
And He is with you wherever you are.
